newsitem.title: UK: Vanguard says 3 drugs ahead of test schedule.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard says 3 drugs ahead of test schedule.

text.p: Vanguard Medica said on Monday that clinical programmes for its drugs against migraine, hyperphosphataemia and inflammatory diseases were ahead of schedule.
Vanguard, which earlier reported full-year losses had widened to 10.95 million stg from 3.56 million, said phase IIb results for its migraine drug VML 251 were most encouraging.
Phase II trials in the U.S. for VML 252 against hyperphosphataemia are due to begin in the second quarter of this year.
VML 253 against inflammatory diseases has already started phase II trials against psoriasis and ulcerative colitis.
Fledgling biotech firm Vanguard said it had sunk deeper into the red because of accelerated clinical trial programmes.

The company, which was floated in May last year, said it had 51.8 million stg in cash and added it was continuously in talks with other firms on potential collaboration in developing and marketing new compounds.
